verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own documented bulk mechanism is realm import/export as JSON files, plus export/import of authorization configuration and operator-automated realm import. These move many users, clients and policies at once, but they are whole-configuration transfers rather than general bulk actions on selected items. kcadm.sh and the Admin REST API are only scripting building blocks, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented bulk actions on selected items (e.g. bulk disable/delete/role-assign of many users), documented partial or incremental bulk import, and hands-on corroboration at scale (one community note says loading a realm from JSON works but keeping later changes synced is hard).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
